description.zh: 模拟一次完整的 Codex turn：用户请求修复 Rust 编译错误 → run_turn() 外层循环 → try_run_sampling_request() 内层 SSE 流 → FuturesOrdered 并行执行工具 → needs_follow_up 决策 → turn 结束。每一步对应 core/src/codex/turn.rs 的实际代码路径。
description.en: Simulate a complete Codex turn: user requests Rust compile fix → run_turn() outer loop → try_run_sampling_request() inner SSE stream → FuturesOrdered parallel tool execution → needs_follow_up decision → turn end.
